title: I built a FREE tool to generate NES and SNES style music for PixelArt type games
author: estebansaa
selftext:
I know there are many options to generate music using ai, but they do not sound like the classic NES and SNES games music. The same for soundfx, you can match the exac vibes of the classic NES and SNES games sounds. Is completelly free: [https://vibingtools.accessagent.ai/](https://vibingtools.accessagent.ai/)

Lets me know any ideas or feedback to improve it! Enjoy!

comments.author: Segaiai
comments.body: This is cool, but how do I get to the SNES section? All I see is NES. SNES sounded a LOT different than NES.

replies.author: estebansaa
replies.body: Thank you. yeah, I only go the NES section working, now that you comment that pushes me to get the SNES one done.  Give me some details of what you need, and will update the site.

replies.author: Segaiai
replies.body:
I wanted to make some SNES music. 

Also, a suggestion for what's already there: you have an example prompt for sound effects. The music should have a different example prompt, to show what it's expecting you to type in there.

replies.author: estebansaa
replies.body: sure, give me a day or two, have some ideas. If you were trying to generate and failed, I fixed that now.
